reports.title_zh: 地雷、未爆彈與爆炸性殘餘物（ERW）的清除成本，主要由搜尋面積決定。全球15國疑似區的實物命中率不足3%。機械化的價值在「縮減要搜的面」，不在單次探測。本題只量化一條鏈：每公頃成本、速度與民生損失。
軍車訓練揚塵：一趟履帶車已把粉塵潛勢推高 569%，真正槓桿是土壤濕度與車次
reports.title_en: Military Training Dust: One Tracked Pass Dominates; Soil Moisture and Pass Limits Are the Levers

reports.title_zh: 同一座海底廢彈場內，貽貝累積的爆炸物可相差一個數量級。清除工程應先移走散落的有機炸藥殘塊，還是鏽蝕中的金屬彈體？本報告以德國基爾灣 Kolberger Heide 為例，量化兩條暴露路徑的健康風險差異。
美軍固體火箭與炸藥設施曾把高氯酸鹽釋放到基地地下水井，最高达每公升 18.1 毫克。麻州 MCL 為 2 ppb，相差逾 9 萬倍。本報告回答三個問題：污染如何形成、為何長期脫離飲水監管、修復要付出多大工程代價。健康證據只作外推，不當作基地居民已受損的證明。
reports.title_en: Military rocket and munitions sites released perchlorate into base groundwater, peaking at 181 mg/L against Massachusetts' 2 ppb limit. This report examines how the plume formed, why drinking-water oversight lagged, and what remediation cost in engineering terms.

reports.title_zh: 過氯酸銨推進劑曾污染美軍多座基地地下水，但聯邦飲用水標準遲至 2026 年才重啟制定。本報告回答：科學證據已支持甚麼風險，而軍方清理與聯邦規則為何長期脫節？
reports.title_en: *Perchlorate propellant contaminated military groundwater, yet no federal drinking-water rule existed until 2026. What does the science support, and why did cleanup and regulation diverge?*

reports.title_zh: 船殼污損會同時增加水阻與油耗，但海軍通常要到油耗帳單和航速下降才察覺。本報告量化一艘主力驅逐艦在「無污損」與「典型污損」之間的年度成本差距，並檢驗主動清洗（自主爬壁機器人）是否回本。
reports.title_en: Hull Fouling on Warships: What Does a 10.3% Resistance Penalty Cost per Year?

reports.title_zh: Titan 內爆後，深海載具安全可拆成兩個可量化問題：壓力殼能否被獨立檢驗，救援能否趕上 96 小時。本文以美海軍所有、WHOI 營運的 Alvin 從 4,500 米升至 6,500 米的認證作工程對照，找出美國民用深潛監管的缺口。
北極軍事基地的凍土融化，是可預算的沉降，還是會提前失效的基礎設施風險？
reports.title_en: Arctic military bases sit on thawing permafrost. The question for planners is whether ground settlement is a budgetable, gradual trend or a failure mode that arrives ahead of schedule.

reports.title_zh: 車底爆震最常傷及足部：離地距、V形船底與延遲截肢的證據鏈
reports.title_en: Underbody blast disproportionately injures the foot; this report traces clearance, hull geometry and delayed amputation.

reports.title_zh: 低強度爆炸訓練會否損害腦健康，關鍵可能不是單次峰值，而是累計劑量。本文比較累積衝量與神經行為症狀、INVICTA 前瞻隊列、MRI 結構病變與退伍軍人長期診斷，並檢視美軍監測為何落後。
reports.title_en: Low-intensity blast training may harm brain health, and the decisive variable may be cumulative dose rather than any single peak overpressure. This report compares accumulated impulse against neurobehavioral symptoms, the prospective INVICTA cohort, MRI structural findings and long-term veteran diagnoses, and asks why US military monitoring lags behind the evidence.

reports.title_zh: 負 G 後急轉正 G，飛行員可短暫失能。本文追問推拉效應的機制、量化門檻與訓練補救，目標是把失能秒數轉成可稽核的安全邊界。
同一枚反車載地雷，為何有人只傷、有人卻當場死亡？本文追問土壤衝量與車體幾何如何決定生存邊界，並找出可轉移到排爆車與事故車的防護原則。
reports.title_en: Why can the same anti-vehicle mine merely injure one crew and instantly kill another? This report traces how soil impulse and vehicle geometry set the survival boundary, and identifies design principles transferable to EOD and crash-response vehicles.

reports.title_zh: 禁用含 PFAS 泡沫後，美軍基地污染為何仍在遷移？
reports.title_en: After the PFAS Foam Ban, Why Is Military-Base Contamination Still Migrating?

reports.title_zh: 美軍燃燒坑新規則為何仍失守：從制度缺口到 1% 風險情境
reports.title_en: Why New Burn Pit Rules Still Fail: From Policy Gap to a 1% Risk Scenario

reports.title_zh: 高氯酸銨是固體火箭推進劑氧化劑，也會污染地下水。EPA 於 2026 年 1 月提出 20、40、80 µg/L 三個 MCL 選項。核心問題：哪個門檻真正保護甲狀腺，成本由誰承擔？
reports.title_en: *Ammonium perchlorate, an oxidizer in solid rocket propellant, contaminates groundwater. EPA's January 2026 proposal offers 20/40/80 µg/L MCLs; which threshold protects thyroid function, and at whose cost?*

reports.title_zh: 美軍穿甲彈由鈾合金轉鎢合金，真係更平、更安全？本題量化比較設施成本、十年生命週期與供應集中度，並檢視健康外部性有無計入。大口徑與小口徑結論相反。
reports.title_en: This report asks whether replacing depleted uranium with tungsten alloy in military penetrators is genuinely cheaper and safer. It compares facility cost, ten-year life-cycle drivers and supply concentration, and checks whether health externalities are priced in.

reports.title_zh: 擋住子彈不等於沒有內傷：44 毫米背形變形的盲區
reports.title_en: A stopped round can still break ribs, lungs or liver

reports.title_zh: 資金只跌5%，全球排雷面積為何跌26%？
reports.title_en: Why Did Global Demining Fall 26% When Funding Fell Just 5%?

reports.title_zh: 高氯酸鹽是固體火箭推進劑氧化劑；美國九成國產量供國防航太。EPA 2026 年 1 月擬議規則一面稱它「不太可能以公共健康關注水平出現」，一面因法院裁決被迫提出強制上限。本報告回答這個矛盾在科學與成本上如何成立，以及軍方自有的 24 ppb 觸發值會否被改寫。
美軍航煤規格如何鎖死 SAF 混掺上限
reports.title_en: How the US Military Fuel Spec Caps SAF Blending

reports.title_zh: 機床油霧「合規」但工人仍然發病：5 與 0.5 mg/m³ 之間的 10 倍落差
reports.title_en: Compliant but Ill: The 10-Fold Gap Between 5 and 0.5 mg/m3 for Machine Mist

reports.title_zh: 工業機器人傷亡集中於非正常狀態：排障、維修與設定，而非常態生產。核心問題是：官方事故數字為何低估真實風險？本報告以 OSHA 嚴重傷害報告、執法案例與製造業傷亡率交叉檢視，並分開事實與推論。重點不是機器人本身，而是安全治理把注意力放錯了狀態。
電動車少用煞車，卻因電池增重多磨輪胎。兩者相加，路面微粒真會下降嗎？答案取決於車重—磨損關係式。
AI 編碼工具到底有冇加快開發者？兩份隨機對照實驗的相反答案
reports.title_en: Do AI Coding Tools Actually Speed Up Developers? Two RCTs, Opposite Answers

reports.title_zh: - 問題：醫院廣泛部署的專有敗血症 AI 模型，真能改善病人結果嗎？
同一批 AI 生成代碼，點解 CodeQL、Bandit、Bearer 會畀出相反安全分數？本報告檢視掃描器覆蓋面、「安全工具」的真實代價，同真實 pull request 數據，追問「AI 代碼風險較高」係咪穩健成立。範圍限公開論文、公開 PR 樣本同大學研究。
reports.title_en: Question: why do three static analyzers disagree on the same AI-generated code? This report tests scanner coverage, the real cost of "secure" patches, and field pull-request data.

reports.title_zh: 模型碳足跡差 100 倍：AI 訓練數字能否支撐電網決策？
reports.title_en: Model Carbon Footprints Differ 100×: Can AI Training Numbers Support Grid Decisions?

reports.title_zh: 除冰鹽用得越少，橋樑是否越安全？本題沿氯離子擴散、腐蝕門檻與替代除冰劑三條線，檢視「少用鹽」能否比「換更貴的鹽」更有效延長鋼筋混凝土橋面壽命。範圍限公路橋面與停車場。
reports.title_en: Does using less de-icing salt keep bridges safer, and can it outperform pricier de-icers? I trace chloride diffusion, corrosion thresholds, and alternative de-icers for reinforced-concrete decks.

reports.title_zh: 同一個 RCM 數值，背後可能差 3.4 倍現場壽命
reports.title_en: The Same RCM Number Can Hide a 3.4× Field-Durability Gap

reports.title_zh: AI 幻覺套件名變成攻擊面：19.7% 幻覺率如何連到 npm 上 1,033 個惡意套件
reports.title_en: Hallucinated Package Names as an Attack Surface

reports.title_zh: 城市山泥傾瀉的預警門檻，應該用「雨量」定還是用「城市」定？全球 26 城資料顯示，77% 城市觸發山泥傾瀉的雨量門檻中位數與全球平均無法區分，31% 更在暴雨極值以下發生：失效主因可能已由氣候轉為人為改山。
reports.title_en: English: Should urban landslide warning thresholds be rainfall-based or city-based? Across 26 cities the median triggering threshold is indistinguishable from the global average in 77% of cities, and 31% of landslides occur below annual rainfall maxima — pointing to engineered slope modification rather than climate as the dominant control.

reports.title_zh: 聖喬昆谷地陷：16年沉降抵得上歷史24年，防洪與輸水工程一齊付帳
reports.title_en: San Joaquin Valley subsidence: 16 years now equals 24 historic years

reports.title_zh: 美軍兒童血鉛檢測率下降，是否足以證明20.3萬套私營家庭住宅已無鉛害？本報告比較全軍檢驗與聯邦審計，區分真實改善、檢測偏差及房屋暴露缺口。核心問題是：下降曲線能否代表暴露源已受控？
reports.title_en: Does a falling blood-lead testing rate among military children prove that the roughly 203,000 privately operated family housing units are lead-free? This report compares service-wide screening with federal audit findings to separate genuine improvement, sampling bias, and housing exposure gaps.

reports.title_zh: GPS 偽造不只是令訊號消失，而是向飛機輸入看似合理的假位置。本報告追問：無加密、無認證的民用 GNSS，如何變成航路與管制風險？以波羅的海事件、飛行員調查與監管指引交叉驗證。
reports.title_en: This report traces how unauthenticated civil GNSS turns interference into plausible-but-wrong aircraft positions, using Baltic operational data, crew survey evidence, and regulator guidance.

reports.title_zh: 美軍以露天燃燒（OB）與露天引爆（OD）處理報廢彈藥，如何把高氯酸鹽送進飲用水；缺碘女性為何是風險放大器。
reports.title_en: How open-air demilitarization delivers perchlorate to tap water, and why iodine-deficient women bear the greatest risk.

reports.title_zh: 機械化農業遇上反車輛地雷：行人安全，不等於車輛安全
reports.title_en: Mechanized Farming Meets Anti-Vehicle Mines

reports.title_zh: 3D 列印金屬件疲勞失效，表面粗糙度與內部孔隙何者主導？HIP 與表面精加工各挽回多少壽命？低成本顯微 CT 能否普及醫療件缺陷檢測？
reports.title_en: For additively manufactured metal parts, does surface roughness or internal porosity dominate fatigue failure? How much life do hot isostatic pressing (HIP) and surface finishing each recover? Can low-cost micro-CT make defect inspection routine for medical parts?

reports.title_zh: 電動車接入低壓配電網，會否加快變壓器熱老化？本報告檢視「午夜後充電」與分時收費會否反效果，並量化機制、成本與可行控制。範圍限住宅配電變壓器。
reports.title_en: Do EVs on low-voltage distribution networks accelerate transformer thermal ageing? This report asks whether charging after midnight, or time-of-use tariffs, can backfire, and quantifies the mechanism, cost and workable control. Scope is limited to residential distribution transformers.

reports.title_zh: 銅價逼近歷史高位：礦場事故、加工費倒掛與硫酸短缺的價格機制
reports.title_en: Copper Near Record Highs: Mine Failures, Negative Treatment Charges and an Acid Shortage

reports.title_zh: 海上風電單樁陰極保護：塗層升級省 79.8% 陽極，能否「順便」降低氫脆風險？
reports.title_en: Offshore Wind Monopile Cathodic Protection: 79.8% Less Anode Mass from Better Coating—Does It Also Reduce Hydrogen Risk?

reports.title_zh: AI 數據中心會把電網推入「低品質」區間嗎？參數、諧波與住宅火災的量化鏈
reports.title_en: Can AI Data Centers Push the Grid into a Low-Quality Band? Quantifying Parameter Growth, Harmonics and Residential Fire Risk

reports.title_zh: PM2.5 低暴露死亡負擔：再降標準仍可避免死亡，但估算可上下翻倍
reports.title_en: Low-level PM2.5 mortality burden: health returns remain below the WHO threshold, while estimates can double

reports.title_zh: 鹹水唔止難飲：海岸鹽化點樣將安全飲用水變成健康暴露
reports.title_en: Salty water is not just unpalatable: how coastal salinization turns "safe" drinking water into a health exposure

reports.title_zh: RTS,S 對 5 至 17 個月兒童的臨床瘧疾效力僅 36.3%，加納、肯亞、馬拉威推行四年後全因兒童死亡率卻降 13%。保護力究竟落在哪條死亡路徑？效價衰減如何侵蝕它？
reports.title_en: RTS,S showed 36.3% efficacy against clinical malaria in young children, yet four years of rollout in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi cut all-cause child mortality by 13%. Where does the protection land on the pathway to death, and how does waning erode it?

reports.title_zh: 美國飲用水新規把PFOA、PFOS上限定為4.0 ng/L。問題是：嚴格門檻波及多少人口，成本多高？其MCLG為零，因EPA判定兩者可能致癌。本報告只計受監測系統，不把名單當全國抽樣。
reports.title_en: The US drinking-water rule sets limits of 4.0 ng/L for PFOA and PFOS. The central questions are how many people are affected and what treatment will cost. The MCLG is zero because EPA considers both substances likely carcinogens. Monitored systems are not treated as a national random sample.

reports.title_zh: 少施氮肥、反而多產：氮效率機制、外部成本與可規模化邊界
reports.title_en: Less Nitrogen, More Yield: Mechanisms, External Costs, and the Limits of Scalability

reports.title_zh: 助聽干預為何「總體陰性、分層有效」：ACHIEVE 試驗 61.6% 效應的機制與邊界
reports.title_en: Why a Null Hearing Trial Split by Risk: The 61.6% ACHIEVE Effect

reports.title_en: Perovskite–Silicon Tandem PV: A 10-Year Module Warranty Against a 25-Year Financing Benchmark

reports.title_zh: 同樣是抗生素失效：兒童抗藥性死亡減逾半、老年人增逾八成
reports.title_en: When Drug Failure Splits by Age: AMR Deaths Halved in Children, Up 80% in the Elderly

reports.title_zh: 半熟料水泥為何仍有同等強度：煅燒黏土與石灰石的協同機制
reports.title_en: Why half-clinker cement keeps its strength: the synergy of calcined clay and limestone

reports.title_zh: 美國職業熱害防護：聯邦執法强度與熱死亡負擔的落差
reports.title_en: US Occupational Heat Protection: The Gap Between Federal Enforcement and Measured Heat Mortality

reports.title_zh: 美國住宅用電負擔正在從「通脹伴生」轉為「設備成本驅動」。本研究回答：2025 年美國零售電價的升幅，究竟有多少來自通脹、有多少來自供電設備本身的成本上升，以及虛擬發電廠（VPP）能否在五年內把家庭賬單增幅壓下一半。範圍限於美國全國平均數據與模型推算，不涵蓋個別州或個別用戶。
reports.title_en: This report asks how much of the 2025 increase in US retail electricity prices came from general inflation versus rising power-system equipment costs, and whether virtual power plants (VPPs) can halve household bill growth within five years. Scope is US national-average data and modelled projections only.
